job.title: Retail & CPG Digital Commerce Consultant (DACH)
job.email_subject: Application: Retail & CPG Digital Commerce Consultant (DACH)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a consultant who knows how commerce platform, OMS and PIM fit together end to end – I have delivered exactly that on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers
– Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, supported UAT
– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Digital Commerce Consultant | Headless Commerce, OMS, PIM & Integrations | SAP
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional digital commerce consultant with 5+ years on enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Understands end to end how commerce platform, OMS, PIM, ERP and MDM fit together: data flows, integration points and headless APIs for PWA storefronts. Works directly with business stakeholders on requirements, process mapping, gap analysis and solution design, and uses generative AI tools across analysis and documentation. Agile, international and SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: SoftServe's Retail & CPG vertical turns client needs into concrete commerce offerings, from headless platforms to OMS, PIM and AI-assisted commerce. That matches my techno-functional experience on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, and I am excited by the chance to bring hands-on platform depth to discovery workshops and solution design in DACH.

en.subject: Application: Retail & CPG Digital Commerce Consultant (DACH)
en.hook: You are looking for a hands-on consultant who can explain how commerce platform, OMS, PIM and data flows fit together end to end – and turn client needs into concrete solutions. That is the ground I have worked on for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I deliver enterprise commerce on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211), between business stakeholders and IT.

bullets.label: E-commerce platforms & headless commerce
bullets.text: Built OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; designed product, catalog, pricing and customer data functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: Order management, PIM & data flows
bullets.text: Developed and maintained Order Management (OMS) and the Promotions Engine; designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Client discovery & solution design
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role, analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions; at Shell, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: AI-assisted commerce delivery
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation – with prompt engineering and critical review of the output through code reviews.

en.logistics: Because I have built these capabilities myself, I can speak credibly with both business and technical stakeholders and make target architectures concrete. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to discuss how I can help scale your Retail & CPG practice in DACH.
